Removing the global cacheMu lock from BuildIndex means two goroutines can now enter the function concurrently for the same key. When the index is file-based (size > FileThreshold), the second goroutine will call bleve.New(dir, mapper) on a directory that already exists, causing it to return an error and fail the search request
TotalDocs() iterates b.cache without holding cacheMu, creating a data race with concurrent Prometheus scrapes during any BuildIndex call
